analysis.reasonEn: RSI maintained neutral at 69.4 after exiting oversold from 68.1. MACD histogram worsened from 4.0233 to 1.0921, but volume ratio surged 1.46x average, confirming Higher Low recovery initiation with price at $179.94 above 5-day low of $169.77. 52-week position at 72.7% indicates strong uptrend.
